OcrEvidence.description: Optional OCR evidence, isolated from pixel measurements.

agrees_with_baseline.description: Exact baseline agreement, absent without comparable observations.

reason.description: Adapter identity or explicit missing-evidence reason.

text.description: Exact observed Unicode scalars; inert data.

Policy.description: Frozen thresholds in physical capture pixels.

minimum_contrast.description: WCAG-style relative luminance ratio (not compliance certification).

minimum_stroke_px.description: Minimum stroke run width in pixels.

minimum_x_height_px.description: Minimum component body-height proxy in sampled pixels.

RegionResult.description: Measurements for one declared text region.

ocr.description: Optional OCR agreement with baseline in this region.

rect_px.description: Region in the current capture, after proportional mapping.

sharpness.description: Minimum per-component normalized maximum edge step.

state.description: Pixel/optional OCR verdict with unavailable evidence kept separate.

stroke_px.description: Minimum component lower-quartile horizontal/vertical run width.

x_height_px.description: Minimum measurable body-height proxy; not inferred typographic x-height.

State.description: Evidence states; absence of a candidate never certifies complete glyph coverage.

oneOf.description: At least one glyph-shaped candidate needs review.
Pixel thresholds are satisfied in a declared text region.
At least one measured threshold fails.
Evidence cannot support a positive verdict.

Variant.description: One variant and all baseline-mapped regions.

regions.description: Every declared region, including unavailable evidence.

Candidate.description: A glyph-shaped observation, never a font/shaping diagnosis.

confidence.description: Heuristic shape score in [0,1], not a calibrated probability.
